scientific_scope: All six source axes and full discovery preserved; 60 minute maximum inclusive pipeline, no minimum
rule: Apply evaluation-contract-v1 lexicographic selection on immutable original A/B assessments and observed paired, failure-inclusive outcomes. Prefer complete source-correct two-screen recipes; compare delivery proxies and context observations separately and record missing billing. A component signal is integration hypothesis only. Select up to two practical 2-4-context exact successors, no inferred multiplicative gains. If none credible, use prospectively labeled diagnostic successors of least-dominated complete recipes, no confirmatory label. Do not select on one fastest passing anecdote.
selection_timing: C recipe/version/allowlist pinned before any C case body reveal; D entire recipe+selection rule pinned before relevant D bodies; no feedback tuning between D repetitions. C may start while unrelated A/B finish once selection evidence sufficient; unassessed methods remain unknown.

D_allocation.D-P01_to_P04: recipe1 vs R0, four independent fresh cases
D_allocation.D-P05_to_P08: recipe2 vs R0, four independent fresh cases

fallback_allocation: If only one justified recipe, root explicitly freeze named allocation before case reveal; never untouched halfqueue because no early winner.
